about: William M. Berman is a top-rated attorney who practices law in San Diego, California. William Berman focuses on Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues. Additionally, he also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Elder Law.

William Berman received Super Lawyers designation for 2010 - 2026. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 1997. Before practicing law, he attended law school at California Western School of Law and graduated in 1997.
